metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for converting exceptions into structured ErrorEvent objects during LLM response processing. It differs semantically from existing skills: not about inspecting futures (0745223a), not about UI navigation (0a3e55ab), and orthogonal to peer candidates (contextual logging, attribute extraction, stream processing). The peer candidates address logging, telemetry, and stream handling—complementary but separate concerns. Candidate has clear support from Debugging Roadmap and no conflicts. Should be created as a new capability.
